name: Yumiko Ferreira-Adeyemi
subcategory: augmented aerial racing / Apex Drift circuit
description: Yumiko Ferreira-Adeyemi is the reigning Apex Drift Corponation Aerial Racing champion, a Brazilian-Yoruba pilot whose neural-interface integration with her Axiom-manufactured Driftframe is so complete that flight surgeons describe her BCI coupling as 'architecturally indistinguishable from proprioception.' She began racing in informal Tier 2 airspace corridors at fourteen, was sponsored by Axiom at seventeen, and by 2213 had rewritten the Drift record books in four of six circuit categories. Her trademark is flying the tightest urban canyon passes in the league with her haptic feedback deliberately disabled — she calls it 'listening with the frame.'
story_hooks: Ferreira-Adeyemi privately contacts a Tier 2 journalist she grew up near, claiming she has found evidence of the subroutine herself — and that it does something beyond collision avoidance that she cannot explain.
A rival pilot from a competing corponation dies in a crash during a Drift bout with Yumiko; the crash data is sealed by Axiom before independent review, and the dead pilot's family hires a fixer.

During a routine BCI calibration session, Yumiko experiences a cascade of memories that are not hers — they appear to belong to a previous Axiom test pilot whose existence has been scrubbed from public records.
